content: Standard recovery pattern for stateful compression over lossy channels: periodic resynchronization frames/keyframes carrying full (non-delta) state so a receiver that missed prior packets can resynchronize without waiting for a full session restart. This mirrors video codec I-frame/P-frame design, where a dropped frame poisons all dependent delta frames until the next I-frame. Self-describing/idempotent records and explicit sequence numbers let a receiver detect gaps and know when to fall back to raw state versus trust an in-flight delta.
